raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

An Arena episode can retain a failed retry with reward `0` and a successful sibling with reward `r`. When all leaves already have scores, episode reward assignment returns without setting the logical rollout reference. Group normalization then aborts with `Split rollout row rewards differ; supply an explicit rollout_reward for reward normalization.`

Carry the explicit episode reference independently of branch reward propagation. Preserve branch returns, existing references and response validation; a failed terminal response sets the new reference to zero. Already-discounted returns cannot acquire a missing reference after the fact.

Core continuations can also finish with a model failure after earlier completed turns. Validate the complete terminal receipt and retain attributable failures as zero-reward samples. Infrastructure failures, inconsistent outcomes and stale session flags remain rejected. The continuation budget belongs to the runner; no fixed three-turn ceiling is imposed. Legacy diagnostics match the shared typed proxy error message when Core omits its error code.

## Related Issue

Clean main-based adaptation of [519c5adc](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/commit/519c5adc9020db7fe9b3d08c78e4a0929ef2d925). No linked issue. Unrelated metrics and harness configuration changes from that branch are excluded.

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix

## Validation

- **668 passed, 2 skipped** (optional vLLM parser tests require vLLM):

```bash
python -m pytest \
  tests/experimental/openai/test_arena_episode_reward.py \
  tests/experimental/openai/test_context_overflow_recovery.py \
  tests/test_swe_arena_multi_stream.py \
  tests/experimental/openai/test_response_reward_validation.py \
  tests/experimental/openai/test_tool_call_parser.py \
  tests/test_remote_reward_normalization.py -m 'not slow' -q -rs
```

- Regression proof: all four shared-parent retry cases reproduce the exact normalization exception with the unpatched main finalizer, and pass with this fix. Covers cached/uncached export, RPC serialization and normalization with/without standard deviation.
- Full `pre-commit run --all-files` and commit hooks pass.
- No GPU training or live Arena integration was run for this PR. Receipt tests use synthetic fixtures; deployment-level validation remains separate.

## Checklist

- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; regression tests added
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [x] Self-reviewed via the `review-pr` workflow, including independent reward and receipt reviews
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via the `create-pr` workflow

## Additional Context

The main risk is admitting a system failure as model feedback. Tests retain vetoes for timeout/interruption, collection/cleanup failures, conflicting outcomes, service hints and missing/mismatched terminal diagnostics. No configuration schema or dependency changes.
